meta.name: microservices-patterns
meta.description: Design microservices architectures with service boundaries, event-driven communication, and resilience patterns. Use when building distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices.

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构与交互模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正需要设计微服务架构或拆分已有系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design microservices with patterns for boundaries, events, resilience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing microservices or breaking up a monolith.

howto.what: Claude 会依据微服务架构模式,帮你设计分布式系统:按业务能力或子域拆分服务,规划服务间通信(同步或异步),管理数据,并采用熔断、重试等容错模式。
howto.when: 当你说要构建分布式系统、拆分单体应用或实现微服务时,Claude 会触发该技能。

say.text: 帮我把这个单体应用拆分成微服务
say.note: Claude 会分析业务能力并划分服务边界。

say.text: 如何设计订单服务的事件驱动通信？
say.note: Claude 会给出事件流或消息队列的方案。

say.text: 这个系统如何用熔断器增强弹性？
say.note: Claude 会建议合适的弹性模式。

howto.what_en: Claude will use microservices patterns to help design distributed systems: decompose services by business capability or subdomain, plan inter-service communication (sync/async), manage data, and apply resilience patterns like circuit breakers and retries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build distributed systems, decompose monoliths, or implement microservices.

say_en.text: Help me decompose this monolith into microservices.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze capabilities and define service boundaries.

say_en.text: How to design event-driven communication for order service?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest event streaming or message queues.

say_en.text: How to apply circuit breaker for resilience?
